content: Root cause: test_nape_autohook.py called _dispatch_tool without patching srv_module.experiential or SPIRAL_STATE_PATH, writing test-autohook-session entries to live ~/.sovereign/chronicle. Fixed with _isolated_server() context manager that patches both to a tempdir. Added TestChronicleFileNaming regression tests. commit 23e10aa.
